NAIP 2022 visible roof centre independently selected
withheldChecks.use: withheld map-icon versus visible-building check; identity approximate

decision: Reject direct global map-icon georeferencing for precise POIs. Place visible roofs and clearing boundaries from georeferenced NAIP; use event-map topology only for names and broad use areas.
limits: Source-pin/map-symbol consistency is not absolute surveyed accuracy. Per-feature allowances are judgemental planning bounds, not statistical accuracy. Sentinel 10 m acquisitions support broad clearing correspondence only.

pointGeographicCoordinates.label: Front gate / check-in
pointGeographicCoordinates.note: Entrance road near the red schoolhouse, interpreted from the official climbing map; exact gate hardware not resolved.

pointGeographicCoordinates.label: House / west camp buildings
pointGeographicCoordinates.note: Visible roof beside west campground; official climbing map house identity is approximate.

pointGeographicCoordinates.label: Main Stage
pointGeographicCoordinates.note: Visible large roof on the southwest edge of the main field. Both official maps place the stage beside the southern creek bend; icon positions are not survey points.

pointGeographicCoordinates.label: Main Stage Field
pointGeographicCoordinates.note: Visible open field east/northeast of the stage; event-use boundary is estimated.

pointGeographicCoordinates.label: Stargazer camp
pointGeographicCoordinates.note: Central hilltop clearing with visible loop road; organizer identifies Stargazer as the hilltop camp.

pointGeographicCoordinates.label: Harmony Grove
pointGeographicCoordinates.note: Wooded corridor along the eastern road inside the creek loop, south of the Bondfire area; occupancy and path width estimated beneath canopy.

pointGeographicCoordinates.label: Dreamcatcher camp
pointGeographicCoordinates.note: Off-road clearing across the creek east of Harmony Grove; 2025 event map and organizer descriptions establish the camp identity.

pointGeographicCoordinates.label: Family / quiet camp
pointGeographicCoordinates.note: West valley corridor around the visible campground access road, north of the house and adjacent to west creek; not the legacy south/east point.

pointGeographicCoordinates.label: Havanna's Lake (approx.)
pointGeographicCoordinates.note: Venue map lake west of Family camp. Canopy obscures shore; this is an approximate label only, not an RF water polygon.

pointGeographicCoordinates.label: Bondfire / north Harmony
pointGeographicCoordinates.note: Northern end of Harmony Grove near organizer Bondfire location and the climbing-map Harmony boulders; estimated beneath canopy.
